crm_notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood for multiple features: EU-based chat assistant for customer success, doc search across regional data, embeddings for similarity, and reranking. Started on hosted API to move quickly; performance testing moved them toward Dedicated for predictable latency/cost.

Key asks / quotes: “We need EU residence for both model inputs and logs; 3rd party access must be restricted.” CTO (Eva Laurent) on 2026-02-28 call. Legal: wants binding contract clause + audit log access.

Latency/traffic: primary EU user base (FR/DE/UK) - target p95 < 120ms for chat token generation on 1k concurrent avg sessions; bursts to 4k. Cost-sensitivity moderate: willing to commit for 12 months if unit costs drop 30-40% vs hosted pay-as-you-go.

Technical notes: ran hosted demo in eu-west-1, avg token latency 160ms with current prompt engineering. SE recommended KV prefix caching + batching; if Dedicated, test multi-GPU pooling and quantized 34b model. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (quant+batch config).

Routing/residency discussion: prefers single-region EU primary with optional failover to UK region for redundancy. Concern: multi-region routing introduces cross-border copies of KV cache and logs; legal flagged. Suggested approach: keep strict EU primary, use multi-region only for read-only caches, and ensure logs retained in EU.

POC asks: 2-week test covering (1) hosted API in eu-west-1 with synthetic load replicating 1k concurrent, measuring p95 and cost; (2) Dedicated 2-node pool with pinned model and autoscale to 4 nodes for peak; compare latency/cost; (3) confirm KMS integration and SSO SAML login for dev console.

Open items: need legal clause draft, pricing for 12-month reserved capacity banded at 50k-150k ARR, benchmark script from infra (provided by Petal Bridge), clarify backup log retention policy (EU-only).

Short-hand next actions: "POC kickoff 2026-03-15?", Maya to arrange infra + sample workload, Diego to push contract language to legal, SE to prepare benchmark config.
